scheduling: Independent methods within a dataset use afterany to serialize resource use without making one method's success a prerequisite for another. DPS calibration and test require afterok of their previous stage. Every LBM model also requires afterok of the complete verified adapter.
local_baselines: Eight original baseline jobs were cancelled with accounting evidence. Preserve completed results; run remaining baselines locally using the published work_assignment.json.
lbm_protocol: Native lattice units; public solid geometry; boundary_projection=none; do not expose true per-case lid velocity to inference. Formal models require the verified 3125-case, 500000-trajectory release.

evaluation_scope.dps: Train unconditional prior, select sigma on the predeclared validation subset, then evaluate held-out test.
evaluation_scope.dit3d: 100-epoch formal training with validation; held-out prediction evaluation remains a subsequent stage.
evaluation_scope.tensor_dit: Train-only Tucker preparation, validation rank gate, real GPU pilot, 100-epoch formal training; held-out prediction evaluation remains a subsequent stage.

job_evidence: Use per-directory submission.json and the timestamped server_queue.json; test-only job numbers are not submissions.
gpu_execution_status: Pending actual allocations; CPU checks and scheduler preflight do not certify completed training.
